symptom: A message a business event service both publishes and consumes could only be written by declaring it twice (publish, then subscribe): check, exec and mx check passed, and mxbuild --target=deploy failed: 'Extension BusinessEvents deployment failed! System.ArgumentException: An item with the same key has already been added. Key: AgentMessage' (measured 11.12.6, BusinessEvents 3.12.0). Re-running its describe re-minted a channel name every time.
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLService.g4 businessEventMessageDef; mdl/executor/cmd_businessevents.go businessEventServiceModel / businessEventMessageProblems / operationOf / publishSubscribePair. Test: mdl/executor/business_event_publish_subscribe_2490_test.go
cause: MDL had one operation per message, so the only way to state both was two messages of one name; the carry handed out stored operations by message name alone.
insight: **mx check is not the last gate: run the deployment build when the failure is reported at deploy.** mxbuild --target=deploy (with --java-home/--java-exe-path) reproduces the Business Events extension's own check headlessly; mx check passed both shapes. `publish subscribe entity P entity C microflow H` writes one Message with both flags and two operations; the double declaration is now refused by check and exec with the working spelling. Carry operations by (message, operation), or the second operation re-mints and the re-run is never Unchanged.
